_description: The deployed-guest contract GUEST_CONTRACT_VERSION versions: the exec-env keys agentBootEnv writes, the /manage/* surface, and the harness<->bundle handshake types. Written by `node scripts/check-guest-contract.mjs --record|--revise "<reason>"`; history is append-only. See the header of scripts/check-guest-contract.mjs.

history.reason: Baseline. v1-v4 predate this record; their history is the GUEST_CONTRACT_VERSION doc comment in packages/aai-guest-core/src/limits.ts.

GuestRuntime gains an OPTIONAL serveRoute (agent({ routes }) for /api), read only by the harness from the bundle's runtime. A pinned harness never reads it, so a new bundle under it simply serves no /api; a new harness under an old bundle reads undefined and leaves /api to static serving. Neither end can fail, and the platform, which exposes no /:slug/api, cannot observe it.

v5: __aaiCreateRuntime.host (GuestHost) is required — the harness carries no runtime and drives the agent through the bundle's; an older pinned guest ignores the field, and a v5 harness refuses a bundle without it, naming the rebuild
